_README: COPY THIS TO ig-labels.json AND REPLACE EVERY PATTERN WITH TEXT YOU HAVE
The patterns below are EXAMPLES OF THE FORMAT AND NOTHING ELSE. Nobody has
looked at the dashboard they are meant to match. They are not a starting
guess to be trusted — a pattern that matches the wrong number on the page
puts a wrong figure into a row somebody makes a decision from, and it does
it silently. Delete the ones you cannot confirm.
Each value is a regular expression (case-insensitive) matched against the
text nearest a number on the page. If two different numbers match the same
metric, NEITHER is used and the run says so — ambiguity is refused, not
The ten metric keys the board has, and no others:
views reach likes comments shares saves profileTaps avgWatch completion threeSec
